data.name: Ambros
data.gender_notes: Ambros is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word for immortal or everlasting. In Christian tradition, the name Ambrosius or Ambrose refers to the early Christian saint Ambrose of Milan, who was known for his wisdom, faith, and leadership. The name Ambros carries the meaning “Immortal, Everlasting” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ambros usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal, everlasting and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of eternal life and divine wisdom.
data.etymology: Ambros belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Immortal, Everlasting.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ambros total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_greek.name: Αμβρόσιος
in_greek.meaning: Αμβρόσιος σημαίνει αθάνατος, αιώνιος, και συνδέεται με την αιώνια ζωή
in_greek.long_meaning: Αμβρόσιος είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από το ελληνικό και σημαίνει αθάνατος, αιώνιος. Το όνομα συνδέεται με την έννοια της αιωνιότητας και της αθανασίας. Στο χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, το όνομα Αμβρόσιος σχετίζεται με την ιδέα της αιώνιας ζωής και της πνευματικής αθανασίας.
